title: Global South–Canada Mining & Technology Transfer Mission
kicker: The Annual Global South Mining Mission to Greater Sudbury
when: Every June · 2027 mission: first week of June
where: Greater Sudbury and Timmins, Northern Ontario
partner: Co-hosted with Thrive Tours Inc., an Indigenous-led experiential tourism and education company based at Batchewana First Nation
summary: Every June, government and industry delegations from across the Global South come to Greater Sudbury, home to one of the world’s leading mining ecosystems. Over several days, delegates tour working mines and visit equipment and service suppliers, technology developers and research institutions. They meet the people behind them. The mission then travels north to Timmins and ends at the Canadian Mining Expo, where delegates meet Canada’s wider mining supply chain in one place.
programme: The story of Sudbury’s regreening, from environmental damage to one of the world’s best-known recoveries
Mining innovation, including automation, battery-electric equipment and research at Laurentian, Cambrian and NORCAT
Business-to-business meetings between delegates and local mining suppliers and service companies
